# Version 4.153.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m153 engine sync**

## Highlights

In progress, this release syncs the bundled engine to Skia milestone 153.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 153** — Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m153 upstream release line, including a follow-up merge of upstream chrome/m153 bug fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Platform

- **.NET SDK pinned to 10.0.400** — Updates the .NET SDK and container pins used to build and test SkiaSharp to 10.0.400. ([#4884](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4884))
